body.name: Certified graph confidence superset
body.construction: For a model point, evaluate \(\phi_{G,B,s,S,x}(t)=\exp(i t^\top T_S(C)x)\prod_{i\in V}(1+s_i^2[R_S(C)^\top t]_i^2)^{-1}\). Use the empirical characteristic functions at \(j\le J_m\). For each \(G\in\mathcal F\), minimize the truncated weighted discrepancy over the sign-resolved compact exact-support parameter boxes using interval branch-and-bound. Bound inverse changes by \(\|(I-B_{U,U})^{-1}-(I-B'_{U,U})^{-1}\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le\kappa^{-2}\|B-B'\|_{\mathrm{op}}\), bound response changes by \(\|T_S(C(B))-T_S(C(B'))\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le(\kappa^{-1}+L_B\kappa^{-2})\|B-B'\|_{\mathrm{op}}\), and refine until the lower-bound error is at most \(\epsilon_m\). Put \(G\) in \(\widehat{\mathcal C}_m\) when its certified lower discrepancy does not exceed \(\epsilon_m\) plus the certified tolerance.
